units.source_text: 妹尼僧如此悉心看护这女子，不觉过了四五个月，然而并不见效。

en.t: The nun, his younger sister, cared for the woman with such devotion that four or five months passed before she knew it, yet there was still no sign of improvement.

units.source_text: 她很烦恼，便写一封长长的信，派人送到山上去给僧都。

en.t: Deeply troubled, she wrote a long letter and sent someone up the mountain to deliver it to the bishop.

units.source_text: 信中有言道：“我想请兄长下山来，救救这个人。

en.t: In the letter she wrote, "I beg you, elder brother, to come down from the mountain and save this woman.

units.source_text: 她既能挨到今日，足见是不会死的人。

en.t: Since she has endured until today, it is clear that she is not someone destined to die.

units.source_text: 定是顽强的鬼怪只管缠着她不去。

en.t: Surely some stubborn spirit is simply clinging to her and refusing to leave.

units.source_text: 佛一般慈悲的兄长！

en.t: My brother, as compassionate as the Buddha!

units.source_text: 若要你入京，当然不便。

en.t: Of course it would be inconvenient to ask you to enter the capital.

units.source_text: 但到这山麓上总是无妨的吧。”

en.t: But surely there would be no harm in coming as far as this mountain foot."

units.source_text: 言词十分恳切。

en.t: Her words were deeply earnest.

units.source_text: 僧都答书道：“此事实甚奇怪！

en.t: The bishop wrote back, "This matter is truly strange!

units.source_text: 其人竟能延命至今，当时若抛弃不顾，何等可惜！

en.t: That she has managed to live until now is astonishing; how pitiful it would have been if we had abandoned her then!

units.source_text: 我能寻着她，亦定有前世缘分。

en.t: That I was able to find her must also have been due to a bond from a former life.

units.source_text: 今我定当试行救助。

en.t: Now I will certainly try to save her.

units.source_text: 如果救助无效，那是她前世命定了。”

en.t: If my efforts have no effect, then that is what was ordained for her in a former life."

units.source_text: 不久他就下山。

en.t: Before long, he came down from the mountain.

units.source_text: 妹尼僧欢喜拜谢，把几个月以来的情况告诉僧都。

en.t: The younger sister nun joyfully thanked him and told the bishop what had happened over the past several months.

units.source_text: 她说：“病得这样长久的人，形容总是憔悴的。

en.t: She said, "Someone who has been ill for so long is usually wasted in appearance.

units.source_text: 岂知此人姿色一点也不衰减，一直非常清秀，绝无难看之处。

en.t: Yet this woman's beauty has not faded in the slightest; she has remained extraordinarily graceful, without anything unpleasant about her.

units.source_text: 我以为总要完结了，却想不到竟能活到现在。”

en.t: I thought it must surely come to an end, and never imagined she could live until now."

units.source_text: 她怀着满腔热爱之情，啼啼哭哭地说这番话。

en.t: Filled with deep affection, she said this while sobbing.

units.source_text: 僧都说：“我最初找到她时，就觉得相貌异常秀美！

en.t: The bishop said, "When I first found her, I already thought her features were unusually beautiful!

units.source_text: 且让我看一看吧。”

en.t: Let me have a look at her for now."

units.source_text: 便走过去窥探一下，说道：“容貌的确优越非凡！

en.t: He went over and peered at her, then said, "Her appearance truly is extraordinary beyond compare!

units.source_text: 这是前世积德的善报，故能长得如此美貌。

en.t: This beauty must be the good reward for virtue accumulated in a former life.

units.source_text: 大概是犯了某种过错，因而遭逢此种灾厄吧。

en.t: Perhaps she committed some fault and therefore encountered this disaster.

units.source_text: 你曾听到什么消息么？”

en.t: Have you ever heard any news about her?"

units.source_text: 妹尼僧说：“没有，一点也不曾听到。

en.t: The younger sister nun said, "No, I have not heard the slightest thing.

units.source_text: 总之，这人是初濑的观世音菩萨赐给我的。”

en.t: In any case, this woman was granted to me by the Bodhisattva Kannon of Hatsuse."

units.source_text: 僧都说：“总是具有某种因缘，所以赐给你。

en.t: The bishop said, "There must be some karmic bond, and that is why she was granted to you.

units.source_text: 没有因缘，怎么能成事呢？”

en.t: Without such a bond, how could anything come to pass?"

units.source_text: 他认为此事奇特，便开始替她祈祷。

en.t: Thinking the matter strange, he began to pray for her.
